correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact sign-switched affine two-state update A=[[1-s,-alpha*beta],[(1-beta)*lambda,beta]], q=[-s*rho,(1-beta)*lambda*rho], trace(A)=1+beta-s, determinant(A)=beta. The alternating symmetry z_-=-z_+ follows from det(I-A)=s>0, while det(I+A)=2(1+beta)-s gives c=s*rho/[2(1+beta)-s]. Sign consistency and the three Jury inequalities agree exactly on 0<s<2(1+beta); the 2-step Jacobian is A^2. The determinant bound and discriminant yield minimal one-step modulus sqrt(beta) on the claimed closed band. For m_{-1}=0 and s>=2(1+beta), the magnitude recurrence y_{t+1}=(s-1-beta)y_t-beta*y_{t-1}+s*rho starts increasing: at equality increments obey d_{t+1}=beta*d_t+2(1+beta)*rho, above equality they grow geometrically. Independently checked orbit equations with exact rational beta in {0,1/3,2/3}, several s, and independent sign conventions. This proves only the fixed-preconditioner scalar deterministic case, not adaptive or stochastic SAM.
residual_risks: Finite orbit checks do not replace the recurrence/Jury proof; the result does not extend to adaptive preconditioners.
